title: Hanuma conquers Lanka
introduction: In this chapter Hanuma faces Lanka, the city of Lanka herself in the form of a demoness.
closing: || इति श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकान्ण्डे तृतयः सर्गः ||
Thus completes the third chapter of Sundara Kanda in Valmiki Ramayana, the first poem.

verses.devanagari:
स लम्ब शिखरे लम्बे लम्ब तोयद सम्निभे |
सत्त्वम् आस्थाय मेधावी हनुमान् मारुत आत्मजः
निशि लन्काम् महा सत्त्वः विवेश कपि कुन्जरः |
रम्य कानन तोय आढ्याम् पुरीम् रावण पालिताम्
verses.iast:
sa lamba śikhare lambe lamba toyada samnibhe |
sattvam āsthāya medhāvī hanumān māruta ātmajaḥ
niśi lankām mahā sattvaḥ viveśa kapi kunjaraḥ |
ramya kānana toya āḍhyām purīm rāvaṇa pālitām
verses.translation: That Hanuma, best among monkeys, the intellectual son of Vayu, one with great might, stood on the  moutain called Lamba with its high peaks equalling a high cloud, gathered courage and entered at night the city  of Lanka ruled by Ravana and filled with beautiful forests and places of water such as lakes.

glosses.meaning: and filled with beautiful forests and (places of) water.

verses.devanagari:
शारद अम्बु धर प्रख्यैः भवनैः उपशोभिताम् |
सागर उपम निर्घोषाम् सागर अनिल सेविताम्
सुपुष्ट बल सम्गुप्ताम् यथैव विटपावतीम् |
चारु तोरण निर्यूहाम् पाण्डुर द्वार तोरणाम्
verses.iast:
śārada ambu dhara prakhyaiḥ bhavanaiḥ upaśobhitām |
sāgara upama nirghoṣām sāgara anila sevitām
supuṣṭa bala samguptām yathaiva viṭapāvatīm |
cāru toraṇa niryūhām pāṇḍura dvāra toraṇām
verses.translation: The city of Lanka was shone by buildings equalling autumnal clouds. With a sound resembling that  of an ocean, it was served by ocean breeze. It was filled with well fed and mighty armies like Vitapati, the capital  of Kubera. It had elephants positioned at archways and had white gates and archways.

glosses.meaning: with a sound resembling that of an ocean

verses.devanagari:
भुजग आचरिताम् गुप्ताम् शुभाम् भोगवतीम् इव |
ताम् सविद्युत् घन आकीर्णाम् ज्योतिः मार्ग निषेविताम्
चण्ड मारुत निर्ह्रादाम् यथा इन्द्रस्य अमरावतीम् |
शातकुम्भेन महता प्राकारेण अभिसम्वृताम्
किन्किणी जाल घोषाभिः पताकाभिः अलम्कृताम् |
आसाद्य सहसा हृष्टः प्राकारम् अभिपेदिवान्
verses.iast:
bhujaga ācaritām guptām śubhām bhogavatīm iva |
tām savidyut ghana ākīrṇām jyotiḥ mārga niṣevitām
caṇḍa māruta nirhrādām yathā indrasya amarāvatīm |
śātakumbhena mahatā prākāreṇa abhisamvṛtām
kinkiṇī jāla ghoṣābhiḥ patākābhiḥ alamkṛtām |
āsādya sahasā hṛṣṭaḥ prākāram abhipedivān
verses.translation: Quickly approaching that city of Lanka which was protected by Rakshasas, like the the auspicious  city of Bhogavati being protected by serpents moving about, spread with cloud illumined by flashes of lightening,  served by pathways of stars, witha light breeze like the Indra's city of Amaravati, surrounded by a wall with  a golden hue, decorated by flags with sounds from groups of small bells. He became happy and leapt up the wall.

glosses.meaning: with sounds from groups of bells

verses.devanagari:
विस्मय आविष्ट हृदयः पुरीम् आलोक्य सर्वतः |
जाम्बूनदमयैः द्वारैः वैदूर्य कृत वेदिकैः
मणि स्फटिक मुक्ताभिः मणि कुट्टिम भूषितैः |
तप्त हाटक निर्यूहैः राजत अमल पाण्डुरैः
वैदूर्य तल सोपानैः स्फाटिक अन्तर पांसुभिः |
चारु सम्जवन उपेतैः खम् इव उत्पतितैः शुभैः
क्रौन्च बर्हिण सम्घुष्टे राज हंस निषेवितैः |
तूर्य आभरण निर्घोषैः सर्वतः प्रतिनादिताम्
वस्वोकसारा प्रतिमाम् समीक्ष्य नगरीम् ततः |
खम् इव उत्पतिताम् लन्काम् जहर्ष हनुमान् कपिः
verses.iast:
vismaya āviṣṭa hṛdayaḥ purīm ālokya sarvataḥ |
jāmbūnadamayaiḥ dvāraiḥ vaidūrya kṛta vedikaiḥ
maṇi sphaṭika muktābhiḥ maṇi kuṭṭima bhūṣitaiḥ |
tapta hāṭaka niryūhaiḥ rājata amala pāṇḍuraiḥ
vaidūrya tala sopānaiḥ sphāṭika antara pāṃsubhiḥ |
cāru samjavana upetaiḥ kham iva utpatitaiḥ śubhaiḥ
kraunca barhiṇa samghuṣṭe rāja haṃsa niṣevitaiḥ |
tūrya ābharaṇa nirghoṣaiḥ sarvataḥ pratināditām
vasvokasārā pratimām samīkṣya nagarīm tataḥ |
kham iva utpatitām lankām jaharṣa hanumān kapiḥ
verses.translation: Seeing the city everywhere Hanuma became surprised at heart. Thereafter Hanuma the monkey, became  happy seeing the doors which were of golden color, with platforms of cat's eye gems, inlaid with diamonds, crystals  and pearls, embellished with floors of gems, graced with elephants made of refined gold, crowned with spotless  white silver, stairs studded with cat's eye gems, with inside walls made of crystal free from dust, provided with  lovely assembly halls, with sounds of Krauncha birds and peacocks, served by royal swans, looking as though flying  toward the sky, with auspicious houses resounding everywhere with the sounds of clarionets and ornaments, equalling  the city of Vasvaukasaara, as though flying towards the sky.

glosses.meaning: with platforms of cat's eye gems
graced with elephants made of refined gold
stairs studded with cat's eye gems
with inside walls made of crystal free from dust
with sounds of Krauncha birds and peacocks
with the sounds of clarionets and ornaments

verses.devanagari:
ताम् समीक्ष्य पुरीम् लन्काम् राक्षस अधिपतेः शुभाम् |
अनुत्तमाम् ऋद्धि युताम् चिन्तयाम् आस वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
tām samīkṣya purīm lankām rākṣasa adhipateḥ śubhām |
anuttamām ṛddhi yutām cintayām āsa vīryavān
verses.translation: Seeing that city of Ravana, which was best among cities, a wealthy city, a beautiful and auspicious  city, that powerful Hanuma thought thus.

verses.devanagari:
न इयम् अन्येन नगरी शक्या धर्षयितुम् बलात् |
रक्षिता रावण बलैः उद्यत आयुध धारिभिः
verses.iast:
na iyam anyena nagarī śakyā dharṣayitum balāt |
rakṣitā rāvaṇa balaiḥ udyata āyudha dhāribhiḥ
verses.translation: "It is not possible for anyone else to oppose this city, by strength alone, which is being guarded  by armies of Ravana with raised weapons."

verses.devanagari:
कुमुद अन्गदयोः वा अपि सुषेणस्य महा कपेः |
प्रसिद्धा इयम् भवेत् भूमिः मैन्द द्विविदयोः अपि
verses.iast:
kumuda angadayoḥ vā api suṣeṇasya mahā kapeḥ |
prasiddhā iyam bhavet bhūmiḥ mainda dvividayoḥ api
verses.translation: This land may be conquerable by Kumuda or Angada, to the great monkey Sushena or to Mainda or Dvivida.

verses.devanagari:
विवस्वतः तनूजस्य हरेः च कुश पर्वणः |
ऋक्षस्य केतु मालस्य मम चैव गतिः भवेत्
verses.iast:
vivasvataḥ tanūjasya hareḥ ca kuśa parvaṇaḥ |
ṛkṣasya ketu mālasya mama caiva gatiḥ bhavet
verses.translation: There may be access to this land to the son of Sun God Sugreeva, to the monkey Kusaparvana, to  the chief among monkeys Riksha and to me.

glosses.meaning: to son of Sun God - Sugreeva
to the chief among monkeys Riksha

verses.devanagari:
समीक्ष्य तु महा बाहः राघवस्य पराक्रमम् |
लक्ष्मणस्य च विक्रान्तम् अभवत् प्रीतिमान् कपिः
verses.iast:
samīkṣya tu mahā bāhaḥ rāghavasya parākramam |
lakṣmaṇasya ca vikrāntam abhavat prītimān kapiḥ
verses.translation: Considering the long armed Sri Rama's strength and Lakshmana's valour, Hanuma became happy.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् रत्न वसन उपेताम् कोष्ठ आगार अवतंसकाम् |
यन्त्र अगार स्तनीम् ऋद्धाम् प्रमदाम् इव भूषिताम्
ताम् नष्ट तिमिराम् दीपैः भास्वरैः च महा गृहैः |
नगरीम् राक्षस इन्द्रस्य ददर्श स महा कपिः
verses.iast:
tām ratna vasana upetām koṣṭha āgāra avataṃsakām |
yantra agāra stanīm ṛddhām pramadām iva bhūṣitām
tām naṣṭa timirām dīpaiḥ bhāsvaraiḥ ca mahā gṛhaiḥ |
nagarīm rākṣasa indrasya dadarśa sa mahā kapiḥ
verses.translation: That great monkey saw that city of king of rakshasas like a wealthy woman decorated with diamonds  for her clothes, with various storage houses as earrings, with amouries for her breasts. Due to the lamps that  illuminated the radiant great houses, all darkness was lost.

glosses.meaning: with various storage houses as earrings

verses.devanagari:
अथ सा हरिशार्दूलम् प्रविशन्तिम् महाबलम् |
नगरी स्वेन रूपेण ददर्श पवनात्मजम्
verses.iast:
atha sā hariśārdūlam praviśantim mahābalam |
nagarī svena rūpeṇa dadarśa pavanātmajam
verses.translation: Thereafter, the guardian of that city, in her own form, saw Hanuma, the best among monkeys and  the mighty one, entering.

verses.devanagari:
सा तम् हरिवरम् दृष्ट्वा लङ्का रावणपालिता |
स्वयमेवोत्थिता तत्र विकृताननदर्शना
verses.iast:
sā tam harivaram dṛśhṭvā laṇ^kā rāvaṇapālitā |
svayamevotthitā tatra vikṛtānanadarśanā
verses.translation: Seeing that best among monkeys Hanuma there, that Lanka ruled by Ravana, rose up herself with a  horrific appearance of face an eyes.

glosses.meaning: with a horrific appearence of face and eyes.

verses.devanagari:
पुरस्तत्क पिवर्यस्य वायुसूनोरतिष्ठत |
मुञ्चमाना महानादमब्रवीत्पवनात्मजम्
verses.iast:
purastatka pivaryasya vāyusūnoratiśhṭhata |
muJṇcamānā mahānādamabravītpavanātmajam
verses.translation: She stood in front of the best among Vanaras Hanuma. She made a great sound and spoke to Hanuma  thus.

verses.devanagari:
कस्त्वम् केन च कार्येण इह प्राप्तो वनालय |
कथय स्वेह यत्तत्त्वम् यावत्प्राणा धरन्ति ते
verses.iast:
kastvam kena ca kāryeṇa iha prāpto vanālaya |
kathaya sveha yattattvam yāvatprāṇā dharanti te
verses.translation: "O one who lives in gardens! Who are you? For what reason did you come here? As long as your lives  are sustained, tell me the truth here before that."

glosses.meaning: O one who lives in gardens

verses.devanagari:
न शक्यम् खल्वियम् लङ्का प्रवेष्टुम् वानर त्वया |
रक्षिता रावणबलैरभिगुप्ता समन्ततः
verses.iast:
na śakyam khalviyam laṇ^kā praveśhṭum vānara tvayā |
rakśitā rāvaṇabalairabhiguptā samantataḥ
verses.translation: "O Vanara! It is indeed not possible for you to enter this city of Lanka which is protected by  Ravana's forces and strongly guarded all around."

verses.devanagari:
अथ तामब्रवीद्वीरो हनुमानग्रतः स्थिताम् |
कथयिष्यामि ते तत्त्वम् यन्मम् त्वम् परिपृच्छसि
verses.iast:
atha tāmabravīdvīro hanumānagrataḥ sthitām |
kathayiśhyāmi te tattvam yanmam tvam paripṛcchasi
verses.translation: Therafter the mighty Hanuma spoke to Lanka standing in front of Him as follows : "Whatever matter  you are asking me, I will tell you that truthfully."

verses.devanagari:
का त्वम् विरूपनयना पुरद्वारेऽवतिष्ठसि |
किमर्थम् चापि माम् रुद्ध्वा निर्भर्त्सयसि दारुणा
verses.iast:
kā tvam virūpanayanā puradvāre'vatiśhṭhasi |
kimartham cāpi mām ruddhvā nirbhartsayasi dāruṇā
verses.translation: "You are standing at the entrance to the city. O one with ugly eyes! Who are you? O horrible one!  Stopping me, for what reason are you threatening me?"

verses.devanagari:
हनुमद्वचनम् श्रुत्वा लङ्का सा कामरूपिणी |
उवाच वचनम् क्रुद्धा परुषं पवनात्मजम्
verses.iast:
hanumadvacanam śrutvā laṇ^kā sā kāmarūpiṇī |
uvāca vacanam kruddhā paruśhaṃ pavanātmajam
verses.translation: Listening to Hanuma's words, that Lanka, with ability to achieve desired form, became angry and  spoke these strong words to Hanuma.

glosses.meaning: with ability to change form according to will

verses.devanagari:
अहम् राक्षसराजस्य रावणस्य महात्मनः |
आज्ञाप्रतीक्षा दुर्धर्षा रक्षामि नगरीमिमाम्
verses.iast:
aham rākśasarājasya rāvaṇasya mahātmanaḥ |
ājJṇāpratīkśā durdharśhā rakśāmi nagarīmimām
verses.translation: "I protect this city, being invincible. I wait for the orders of the king of demons Ravana, the  great one."

verses.devanagari:
न शक्या मामवज्ञाय प्रवेष्टुम् नगरी त्वया |
अद्य प्राणैः परित्यक्तः स्वप्स्यसे निहतो मया
verses.iast:
na śakyā māmavajJṇāya praveśhṭum nagarī tvayā |
adya prāṇaiḥ parityaktaḥ svapsyase nihato mayā
verses.translation: "After humilliating me it is not possible for you to enter the city. Being beaten by me, you will  leave life and have a permanent sleep."

verses.devanagari:
अहम् हि नगरी लङ्का स्वयमेव प्लवङ्गम |
सर्वतः परिरक्षामि ह्येतत्ते कथितम् मया
verses.iast:
aham hi nagarī laṇ^kā svayameva plavaṇ^gama |
sarvataḥ parirakśāmi hyetatte kathitam mayā
verses.translation: "O Vanara! I am protecting this city of Lanka in all directions. This matter has been already told  to you by me."

verses.devanagari:
लङ्काया वचनम् श्रुत्वा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः |
यत्नवान्स हरिश्रेष्ठः स्थितश्शैल इवापरः
verses.iast:
laṇ^kāyā vacanam śrutvā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ |
yatnavānsa hariśreśhṭhaḥ sthitaśśaila ivāparaḥ
verses.translation: The son of Vayu and best among Vanaras heard Lanka's words and stood up like a second mountain,  with a purpose.

verses.devanagari:
स ताम् स्त्रीरूपविकृताम् दृष्ट्वा वानरपुङ्गवः |
आबभाषेऽथ मेधावि सत्त्वान् प्लवगर्षभः
verses.iast:
sa tām strīrūpavikṛtām dṛśhṭvā vānarapuṇ^gavaḥ |
ābabhāśhe'tha medhāvi sattvān plavagarśhabhaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter that Hanuma the wise one, with great strength, best among those who can fly and best  among Vanaras, saw that city of Lanka in the form of an ugly woman and spoke thus.

glosses.meaning: best among those who can fly
in the form of a lady and ugly

verses.devanagari:
द्रक्ष्यामि नगरीम् लङ्काम् साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम् |
इत्यर्थमिह सम्प्राप्तः परम् कौतूहलम् हि मे
verses.iast:
drakśyāmi nagarīm laṇ^kām sāṭṭaprākāratoraṇām |
ityarthamiha samprāptaḥ param kautūhalam hi me
verses.translation: "I should like to see the city of Lanka with its palaces, defensive walls and archways. I came  here for that reason. I am very curious to see them."

verses.devanagari:
वनान्युपवनानीह लङ्कायाः काननानि च |
सर्वतो गृहमुख्यानि द्रष्टुमागमनम् हि मे
verses.iast:
vanānyupavanānīha laṇ^kāyāḥ kānanāni ca |
sarvato gṛhamukhyāni draśhṭumāgamanam hi me
verses.translation: "My arrival here is indeed to see Lanka's gardens, parks, forests and important houses all over."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तद्वचनम् श्रुत्वा लङ्का सा कामरूपिणी |
भूय एव पुनर्वाक्यम् बभाषे परुषाक्षरम्
verses.iast:
tasya tadvacanam śrutvā laṇ^kā sā kāmarūpiṇī |
bhūya eva punarvākyam babhāśhe paruśhākśaram
verses.translation: Listening to Hanuma's words, Lanka with the ability to assume desired form, spoke harsh words stronger  than before.

glosses.meaning: Lanka with the ability to change form according to will

verses.devanagari:
मामनिर्जत्य दुर्बद्धे राक्षसेश्वरपालिता |
न शक्यमद्य ते द्रष्टुम् पुरीयम् वनराधम
verses.iast:
māmanirjatya durbaddhe rākśaseśvarapālitā |
na śakyamadya te draśhṭum purīyam vanarādhama
verses.translation: "O lowly Vanara with an evil mind! It is not possile for you to see this city ruled by king of  rakshasas, without first defeating me."

glosses.meaning: O lowly Vanara! durbuddhe = with evil mind

verses.devanagari:
ततः स कपिशार्दूलस्तामुवाच निशाचरीम् |
दृष्वा पुरीमिमाम् भद्रे पुनर्यास्ये यथागतम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa kapiśārdūlastāmuvāca niśācarīm |
dṛśhvā purīmimām bhadre punaryāsye yathāgatam
verses.translation: Then that tiger among Vanaras Hanuma spoke to that demon : "O auspicious one! After seeing this  city I will return back again to where I came from."

glosses.meaning: O auspicious one! dR^ishhTvaa = after seeing

verses.devanagari:
ततः कृत्वा महानादम् सा वै लङ्का भयावहम् |
तलेन वानरश्रेष्ठम् ताडयामास वेगिता
verses.iast:
tataḥ kṛtvā mahānādam sā vai laṇ^kā bhayāvaham |
talena vānaraśreśhṭham tāḍayāmāsa vegitā
verses.translation: Thereafter that Lanka made a great sound causing terror and hit Hanuma, the best among Vanaras,  with her palm quickly.

verses.devanagari:
ततः स कपिशार्दुलो लङ्काया ताडितो भृशम् |
ननाद सुमहानादम् वीर्यवान् पवनात्मजः
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa kapiśārdulo laṇ^kāyā tāḍito bhṛśam |
nanāda sumahānādam vīryavān pavanātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Then that tiger among Vanaras, the powerful son of Vayu, being hit powerfully by Lanka made a great  sound.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सम्वर्तयामास वामहस्तस्य सोऽङ्गुळीः |
मुष्टिनाभिजघूनैनाम् हनुमान् क्रोधमूर्चितः
स्त्री चेति मन्यमानेन नातिक्रोधः स्वयम् कृतः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ samvartayāmāsa vāmahastasya so'ṇ^guLīḥ |
muṣṭinābhijaghūnainām hanumān krodhamūrcitaḥ
strī ceti manyamānena nātikrodhaḥ svayam kṛtaḥ |
verses.translation: Thereafter that Hanuma became dizzy with anger and folded his fingers of left hand. He then hit  her with His fist. "She is a woman" - thinking thus He did not show much anger by Himself.

verses.devanagari:
सा तु तेन प्रहारेण विह्वलाङ्गी नीशाचरी
पपात सहसा भूमौ विकृताननदर्शना |
verses.iast:
sā tu tena prahāreṇa vihvalāṇ^gī nīśācarī
papāta sahasā bhūmau vikṛtānanadarśanā |
verses.translation: That demon fell on land immediately by that hit with a distressed body and appeared with a horrific  face.

glosses.meaning: and became with a horrific face in appearance.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु हनुमान् प्राज्ञस्ताम् दृष्ट्वा विनिपातिताम्
कृपाम् चकार तेजस्वी मन्यमानः स्त्रियम् तु ताम् |
verses.iast:
tatastu hanumān prājJṇastām dṛśhṭvā vinipātitām
kṛpām cakāra tejasvī manyamānaḥ striyam tu tām |
verses.translation: Thereafter the intellectual and glorious Hanuma saw her fallen down and thinking her to be woman,  showed kindness.

verses.devanagari:
ततो वै भृशसम्विग्ना लङ्का गद्गदाक्षरम्
उवाचागर्वितम् वाक्यम् हनूमन्तम् प्लवङ्गमम् |
verses.iast:
tato vai bhṛśasamvignā laṇ^kā gadgadākśaram
uvācāgarvitam vākyam hanūmantam plavaṇ^gamam |
verses.translation: Thereafter that Lanka being very gloomy spoke with a falterting tone without pride these words  to Hanuma the Vanara.

verses.devanagari:
प्रसीद सुमहाबाहो त्रायस्व हरिसत्तम
समये सौम्य तिष्ठन्ति स्त्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः |
verses.iast:
prasīda sumahābāho trāyasva harisattama
samaye saumya tiśhṭhanti sttvavanto mahābalāḥ |
verses.translation: "O long armed one! O best among Vanaras! Get propitiated and protect me. O gentle one! Those with  great strength and courage always stand firm on tradition."

verses.devanagari:
अहं तु नगरी लङ्का स्वयमेव प्लवङ्गम
निर्जिताहम् त्वया वीर विक्रमेण महाबल |
verses.iast:
ahaṃ tu nagarī laṇ^kā svayameva plavaṇ^gama
nirjitāham tvayā vīra vikrameṇa mahābala |
verses.translation: "O Vanara! I am myself the city of Lanka. O strong one! O courageous one! I am defeated by your  strength."

glosses.meaning: O Vanara! aham tu = I am
O strong one! viia = O courageous one! aham = I

verses.devanagari:
इदम् तु तथ्यम् शृणु वै ब्रुवन्त्य मे हरीश्वर
स्वयम्भुवा पुरा दत्तम् वरदानम् यथा मम |
verses.iast:
idam tu tathyam śṛṇu vai bruvantya me harīśvara
svayambhuvā purā dattam varadānam yathā mama |
verses.translation: "O lord of Vanaras! In earlier times I had been given a boon by Lord Brahma. Hear from me about  this matter."

glosses.meaning: O lord of Vanaras! puraa = in earlier times

verses.devanagari:
यदा त्वाम् वानरः कश्चिद्विक्रमाद्वशमानयेत्
तदा त्वया हि विज्ञेयम् रक्षसाम् भयामागतम् |
verses.iast:
yadā tvām vānaraḥ kaścidvikramādvaśamānayet
tadā tvayā hi vijJṇeyam rakśasām bhayāmāgatam |
verses.translation: "Let this be known by you - whenever a Vanara conquers you with his might, then a fear will come  for Rakshasas."

glosses.meaning: let it be known by you.

verses.devanagari:
स हि म् समयः सौम्य प्राप्तोऽय तव द्र्शनात्
स्वयम्भूविहितः सत्यो न तस्यास्ति व्यतिक्रमः |
verses.iast:
sa hi m samayaḥ saumya prāpto'ya tava drśanāt
svayambhūvihitaḥ satyo na tasyāsti vyatikramaḥ |
verses.translation: "O gentle one! With your appearance now, that time has come for me. Ordinance of Brahma is the  truth and is immutable."

glosses.meaning: O gentle one! tava darshanaat = with your apparance

verses.devanagari:
सीतानिमित्तंम् राज्ञस्तु रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
विधत्स्व सर्वकार्याणि यानि यानिह वाञ्चसि |
verses.iast:
sītānimittaṃm rājJṇastu rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
vidhatsva sarvakāryāṇi yāni yāniha vāJṇcasi |
verses.translation: "The destruction has come for Ravana the evil minded king and to all Rakshasas due to Seetha."

verses.devanagari:
तत्प्रविश्य हरिश्रेष्ठम् पुरीम् रावणपालिताम्
विधत्स्व सर्वकार्याण् यानि यानीह वाञ्चसि |
verses.iast:
tatpraviśya hariśreśhṭham purīm rāvaṇapālitām
vidhatsva sarvakāryāṇ yāni yānīha vāJṇcasi |
verses.translation: "O best aming Vanaras! For that reason, enter the city of Lanka ruled by Ravana and do here whatever  tasks you want to."

glosses.meaning: O best among Vanaras! tat = for that reason

verses.devanagari:
प्रविश्य शापोपहताम् हरीश्वर |
शुभाम् पुरीम् राक्षसराजपालिताम् |
यदृच्छया त्वम् जनकात्मजाम् सतीम् |
विमार्ग सर्वत्र गतो यथासुखम्
verses.iast:
praviśya śāpopahatām harīśvara |
śubhām purīm rākśasarājapālitām |
yadṛcchayā tvam janakātmajām satīm |
vimārga sarvatra gato yathāsukham
verses.translation: "O lord of Vanaras! Enter the auspicious city of Lanka stuck by the curse, ruled by the king of  Rakshasas, roam everywhere and search for the chaste wife Seetha according to your comfort."

glosses.meaning: O lord of Vanaras! pravishya = enter
ruled by the king of Rakshasas
